contents.description: Provides rich language support untuk JSON berkas.
contents.json.schemas.desc: Associate schemas to JSON berkas in the saat ini project.
contents.json.schemas.url.desc: A URL atau absolute berkas path to a schema. Can be a relative path (memulai dengan `./`) in ruang kerja dan ruang kerja folder pengaturan.
contents.json.schemas.fileMatch.desc: Larik berkas patterns to match against when resolving JSON berkas to schemas. `*` dan `**` can be used as a wildcard. Exclusion patterns can also be defined dan mulai dengan `!`. A berkas matches when there is at least one matching pattern dan the last matching pattern is not an exclusion pattern. In ruang kerja folder pengaturan dan single folder ruang kerja pengaturan, `${workspaceFolder}` at the beginning of a pattern expands to the ruang kerja folder, allowing patterns anchored to the ruang kerja folder root (untuk example `${workspaceFolder}/*.json`).
contents.json.schemas.fileMatch.item.desc: A berkas pattern that can contain `*` dan `**` to match against when resolving JSON berkas to schemas. When beginning dengan `!`, it defines an exclusion pattern. In ruang kerja folder pengaturan dan single folder ruang kerja pengaturan, a leading `${workspaceFolder}` expands to the ruang kerja folder.
contents.json.schemas.schema.desc: The schema definition untuk the given URL. The schema only needs to be provided to avoid accesses to the schema URL.
contents.json.format.keepLines.desc: Keep all existing new lines when memformat.
contents.json.tracing.desc: Traces the communication between VS Code dan the JSON language server.
contents.json.colorDecorators.enable.deprecationM: The pengaturan `json.colorDecorators.enable` has been deprecated in favor of `editor.colorDecorators`.
contents.json.maxItemsComputed.desc: The maximum number of outline symbols dan folding regions computed (limited untuk performance reasons).
contents.json.maxItemsExceededInformation.desc: tampilkan notification when exceeding the maximum number of outline symbols dan folding regions.
contents.json.enableSchemaDownload.desc: Saat diaktifkan, JSON schemas can be fetched dari http dan https locations.
contents.json.workspaceTrust: The ekstensi requires ruang kerja trust to load schemas dari http dan https.
contents.json.schemaDownload.trustedDomains.desc: Daftar trusted domains untuk downloading JSON schemas over http(s). Use `*` to trust all domains. `*` can also be used as a wildcard in domain names.
